ZBiotics is generally considered well-tolerated, though some people report ` [Highlight start] mild digestive issues [Highlight end] ` and there is limited published human clinical trial data on its long-term safety.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAbS2M2-ih19aDK614vi92GDZ-zIGg_CgkeqLBcILmSl05ixqTZSjJZiyRWKJpMemVJULiGriG-3XGpEsJTUcpbV94A09ylIUtJAnXMPD9CQW5IsU2j7RNZA6CrhiTgjJ0M8gNcsg4A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF199wAN_47p6wYEqjjrkRu00Gkz1bX_rlerNM5Cw7niXIkqLyV99iWwA2Y_TJlnP2esbgJMDx7AFG5VpTd3Hz7VED_BHqfG_pemdk0D7BiSnHe7Yj5i9LcTF8W-HXCpntRCcoPEblFJJVU1Rou3m7pe5q7dPJmxFeBNOe7pE35kcwesAveGc0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXPe_be6Vs3ekPtQmwZm_9C6NSH-NeLd51r8vhK-PONRxAuvwKYslrz6p-gC0rIeShqD6gcOZF-NvlFb1f_tBifg5ALN7TGGRsqgGfqo2iicbmFkxSaCMZMiTrdgnZznPjS_f1mEl-)

### Reported Side Effects

- **Digestive discomfort:** Mild upset stomach, gas, or bloating can occur when introducing a probiotic—especially for first-time users—and is usually brief. (Note: ZBiotics also notes gas, bloating, and stool changes when starting its *Sugar-to-Fiber* product).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF199wAN_47p6wYEqjjrkRu00Gkz1bX_rlerNM5Cw7niXIkqLyV99iWwA2Y_TJlnP2esbgJMDx7AFG5VpTd3Hz7VED_BHqfG_pemdk0D7BiSnHe7Yj5i9LcTF8W-HXCpntRCcoPEblFJJVU1Rou3m7pe5q7dPJmxFeBNOe7pE35kcwesAveGc0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXBRPXoB_xhWhKTe2MlO1tMWjKksdQ4BakD4GSHnN2rO_hfBbziud5e_vSYWHzh2zTsunSkHZn8l0E0plYYZ5KZfC4-kYj3I97RAsL_wTdQ17lLAvHamgoEAbTtxrH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHEIkXX4561BXHD-2GqTQvuN5vXLvJ7P56yMm8ZYd1mGB9nHseoosBa5ud22P_peQO1mT8ac9_IuipzBCv5c_SHh75FsMHreFTAQdj5gkhKKSvxzHDHF7V-iw)
- **Nausea and diarrhea:** Opinions on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11fdMA5NdAaxsA29u_xVK0EEKO7OPUgLO88BGsh3-tnOQxxic92fuzPe0jzzifEQOCvr63niMLM4LxOjcLZMlvxxBFeHrchHieqeVp2zx2R64ZROTCmqNy9DOq9f1NPJpdUZylAUVaq9tbPvNCn46WkeQv4mnE4o5XOretoMTzW3JbSpWLId9ZpVonu0nT8J4z1DALI) differ on overall experience with ZBiotics, with some commenters reporting unexpected side effects such as nausea and diarrhea alongside unchanged hangover symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11fdMA5NdAaxsA29u_xVK0EEKO7OPUgLO88BGsh3-tnOQxxic92fuzPe0jzzifEQOCvr63niMLM4LxOjcLZMlvxxBFeHrchHieqeVp2zx2R64ZROTCmqNy9DOq9f1NPJpdUZylAUVaq9tbPvNCn46WkeQv4mnE4o5XOretoMTzW3JbSpWLId9ZpVonu0nT8J4z1DALI)
- **Alcohol-related symptoms:** Because ZBiotics is often taken before drinking alcohol, some stomach discomfort may stem from alcohol itself rather than the probiotic.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF199wAN_47p6wYEqjjrkRu00Gkz1bX_rlerNM5Cw7niXIkqLyV99iWwA2Y_TJlnP2esbgJMDx7AFG5VpTd3Hz7VED_BHqfG_pemdk0D7BiSnHe7Yj5i9LcTF8W-HXCpntRCcoPEblFJJVU1Rou3m7pe5q7dPJmxFeBNOe7pE35kcwesAveGc0)

### Safety & Evidence Notes

- **Ingredient & safety testing:** ZBiotics contains *Bacillus subtilis* ZB183, engineered to produce an enzyme (acetaldehyde dehydrogenase) that breaks down acetaldehyde. According to [ZBiotics](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAbS2M2-ih19aDK614vi92GDZ-zIGg_CgkeqLBcILmSl05ixqTZSjJZiyRWKJpMemVJULiGriG-3XGpEsJTUcpbV94A09ylIUtJAnXMPD9CQW5IsU2j7RNZA6CrhiTgjJ0M8gNcsg4A) , the ingredient underwent safety testing (including a 90-day rodent study with no observed adverse effects) and is self-certified as Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXPe_be6Vs3ekPtQmwZm_9C6NSH-NeLd51r8vhK-PONRxAuvwKYslrz6p-gC0rIeShqD6gcOZF-NvlFb1f_tBifg5ALN7TGGRsqgGfqo2iicbmFkxSaCMZMiTrdgnZznPjS_f1mEl-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAbS2M2-ih19aDK614vi92GDZ-zIGg_CgkeqLBcILmSl05ixqTZSjJZiyRWKJpMemVJULiGriG-3XGpEsJTUcpbV94A09ylIUtJAnXMPD9CQW5IsU2j7RNZA6CrhiTgjJ0M8gNcsg4A)
- **Additives & manufacturing:** Ingredients include water, natural flavoring, and potassium sorbate (an FDA-GRAS preservative). [The Nutrition Insider](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF12vmt72WC-aeivMqErIOc2acGaJGlfPKCxIADCm7yniPNQxg-IRrbp697OhdjXA5Hz6YaU3wBxctPp_NGMlw1V1ZPwllEV_5wu4dirkdiXXqRSgYzbRyJ1Rw5I3Gck00r8ioK0xzS1d_Xm5x9k_EGJ9zjIL9mG1INTVtW7fDazM2NcA) notes that potassium sorbate is considered safe at food-level amounts, and ZBiotics states no major allergens are present (though soy is used in manufacturing).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAbS2M2-ih19aDK614vi92GDZ-zIGg_CgkeqLBcILmSl05ixqTZSjJZiyRWKJpMemVJULiGriG-3XGpEsJTUcpbV94A09ylIUtJAnXMPD9CQW5IsU2j7RNZA6CrhiTgjJ0M8gNcsg4A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF12vmt72WC-aeivMqErIOc2acGaJGlfPKCxIADCm7yniPNQxg-IRrbp697OhdjXA5Hz6YaU3wBxctPp_NGMlw1V1ZPwllEV_5wu4dirkdiXXqRSgYzbRyJ1Rw5I3Gck00r8ioK0xzS1d_Xm5x9k_EGJ9zjIL9mG1INTVtW7fDazM2NcA)
- **Clinical trial gaps:** Published human clinical trial data evaluating the safety or effectiveness of *Bacillus subtilis* ZB183 specifically is limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXPe_be6Vs3ekPtQmwZm_9C6NSH-NeLd51r8vhK-PONRxAuvwKYslrz6p-gC0rIeShqD6gcOZF-NvlFb1f_tBifg5ALN7TGGRsqgGfqo2iicbmFkxSaCMZMiTrdgnZznPjS_f1mEl-)
